effects.label: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the buff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This buff can be stacked.

levels.text: Casts a [Regeneration] on the ally with the lowest current HP in a 12m radius, lasting 4s. The [Regeneration] buff ticks 1 time every 2s. Each tick heals the target by (2% * Target's MAX HP) HP.

bio: Shalla grew up in the fetid swamps of the Plaguelands, raised by a band of necromancers. It was all she ever knew, until an outsider taught her another path – that of a healer. She defied her cult and joined the Ironbands, now helping to destroy the Undead she was trained to create.
